import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog(heading: str, description: str) -> str: """ Prepare a user‑submitted blog post for safe web display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The main heading or subject of the blog post. description : str The complete textual content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A sanitized and HTML‑formatted string ready for rendering on a webpage. Notes ----- The function escapes all user input to prevent cross‑site scripting (CWE‑79). """ # Escape any HTML special characters in user input safe_heading = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_description = html.escape(description, quote=True) # Insert the escaped values into the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_heading, body=safe_description)
